title: Lecture — Heteroskedasticity
summary: Covers the definition of heteroskedasticity, its consequences for OLS estimation, methods for detection, and potential corrections.

concepts.name: Homoskedasticity
concepts.summary: Homoskedasticity assumes that the error variance conditional on explanatory variables is constant.

concepts.name: Heteroskedasticity
concepts.summary: Heteroskedasticity occurs when the error variance changes across observations with the explanatory variables.

concepts.name: Breusch-Pagan test
concepts.summary: The Breusch-Pagan test is a statistical method used to detect heteroskedasticity in regression models.

concepts.name: White test
concepts.summary: The White test detects heteroskedasticity by checking if the squared residuals depend on the regressors and their squares and cross-products.
